Hausa: Adanawa ta gaza. Fitar da kwafin ajiya kafin rufewa.
Fulfulde: Resugol woorii. Yaltin kopii kisal hade uddude.

English: Enable browser storage and reload to use the offline preview.
Hausa: Kunna ajiyar burauza ka sake buɗewa don amfani da gwajin ba intanet.
Fulfulde: Hurmin resugol browseeɗo tee uddit kadi ngam huutoraade ƴeewtagol ko alaa enternet.

English: Source-adapted design preview. Group discussion prompts are consolidated; the complete extracted source question catalog is in Design & launch plan. Final question wording, matrices and skip rules need survey-owner sign-off.
Hausa: Wannan gwajin tsari ya dogara da takardun asali. An haɗa tambayoyin tattaunawa; cikakken jerin tambayoyin yana cikin Tsari da shirin ƙaddamarwa. Mai binciken dole ya amince da rubutun tambayoyi, jadawali da ƙa'idojin tsallakewa kafin amfani.
Fulfulde: Ɗum ko ƴeewtagol feere iwngol e binndanɗe asliije. Naamne yeewtere kawrinaa; dogol naamne timmungal ena e Feere e porogaraam fuɗɗugol. Jom ƴeewtagol ena haani jaɓde naamne, taabuluuji e sariyaaji diwugol hade huutoraade.

English: Assignment is inherited from your user master. Consent and location exceptions are proposed additions to the source forms.
Hausa: An samo rabon aiki daga rajistar mai amfani. Amincewa da dalilin rashin wuri ƙarin filaye ne da aka ba da shawara.
Fulfulde: Cuɓagol golle iwri e dogol kuutortooɗo. Jaɓɓal e sababuuji ŋakkere nokku ko ɓeydital wasiyaangal e formuuji asliiji.

English: The source participant bands omit 5 and 11–15. The proposed numeric count avoids losing these groups; approval is needed before replacing the original bands.
Hausa: Rukunin adadin mahalarta na asali bai ƙunshi 5 da 11–15 ba. Cikakken adadin da aka ba da shawara zai hana rasa waɗannan rukunin; sai an amince kafin maye gurbin na asali.
Fulfulde: Pelle limoore naatɓe asliije mbaylaani 5 e 11–15. Limoore laaɓtunde wasiyaande ena reena pelle ɗee; jaɓɓal ena haani hade waylude pelle asliije.

Hausa: An ambaci masu tattara bayanai 27; an shirya 30 a Expert-List.
Fulfulde: Mooftooɓe humpito 27 binndaama; 30 faandaama e Expert-List.

English: Server sync is not connected in this design preview. “Device online” only describes connectivity. No local record is marked as uploaded or shared with a supervisor on another device.
Hausa: Ba a haɗa daidaitawa da uwar garke a wannan gwaji ba. “Na'ura na da intanet” yana nufin haɗin intanet kawai. Babu bayanin da aka nuna a matsayin an ɗora ko an rabawa mai kulawa a wata na'ura.
Fulfulde: Jokkondiral server alaa e ƴeewtagol feere ngol. “Masiŋel ena jokkondiri e enternet” ko jokkondiral enternet tan. Alaa humpito maandaama ko neldaaɗo walla lollinaa to ƴeewtoowo e masiŋel goɗngel.

English: Check completeness, units, duplicates, location evidence and consent. A missing location requires an explicit exception note before approval.
Hausa: Duba cikawa, ma'auni, maimaita bayanai, hujjar wuri da amincewa. Idan babu wuri sai an rubuta dalilin keɓancewa kafin amincewa.
Fulfulde: Ƴeewto timmugol, ɓetirɗe, humpito ɓeydaaɗo ɗiɗi, seedeeji nokku e jaɓɓal. So nokku alaa, binndol sababu keeriingu ena haani hade jaɓde.

English: Stored in IndexedDB. Export a backup before clearing site data.
Hausa: An adana a IndexedDB. Fitar da kwafin ajiya kafin share bayanan shafin.
Fulfulde: Resaaɗum e IndexedDB. Yaltin kopii kisal hade momtude humpito lowre.

English: Seeded sample — not a complete submitted questionnaire.
Hausa: Misalin gwaji — ba cikakken binciken da aka miƙa ba.
Fulfulde: Misal ƴeewtagol — wonaa ƴeewtagol timmungal neldaangal.

Hausa: Ba a bayar da dalilin keɓancewa ba

English: Participation consent required. If refused, close as non-participation in production.
Hausa: Ana buƙatar amincewar shiga. Idan an ƙi, rufe a matsayin rashin shiga a ainihin aiki.
Fulfulde: Jaɓɓal naatgol ena haani. So salaama, udd ko naataaki e golle goonga.

English: An LGA assignment is required. Ask the administrator to resolve it.
Hausa: Ana buƙatar ware ƙaramar hukuma. Nemi mai gudanarwa ya warware.
Fulfulde: Cuɓagol LGA ena haani. Naamno jom toppitagol yo feewnu ɗum.

English: Offline shell unavailable in this environment.
Hausa: Ba a samun tsarin aiki ba intanet a wannan yanayi.
Fulfulde: Feere golle ko alaa enternet heɓotaako ɗoo.
